title: Spectral bounds and their limits in Pauli contextuality: exact configurations and a proof of Jonah's Conjecture E
peer_review_status: Research preprint (not peer reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction; listed on ORCID)
author: Alexander Stephen Donahue
core_result: Unified study combining Lean 4 verification of the spectral floor, exact contextuality degrees (75, 480, 729344) for new 4-, 5-, and 7-qubit configurations, a four-qubit cospectral C3 pair with distinct completion spectra, an all-qubit (N >= 4) Lean-checked C3 family, and a self-contained proof settling all nine vertex cases of Jonah's Conjecture E.
verification_boundary: Spectral floor, saturated configurations, and all-qubit C3 family are kernel-checked in Lean 4; non-C3 vertex cases of Conjecture E have self-contained paper proofs checked by exact computation and seven automated adversarial review passes.
